entry.name: receive~
entry.digest: Signals can be received from any loaded patcher, without patch cords
entry.description: Use the receive~ object to grab signals put out by send~ objects and outputs them out its signal outlet. A receive~ object can be instantiated simply by typing into an object box the short-form letter "r~".
